summary.headline: Cadent Lord of the Year
summary.text: Discussion of the king’s significator and the lord of the year in judging the king’s peasants, substance, children, women, health, travel, strength, weakness, and death. Chapter XII explains the effects of a cadent lord of the year, including failure to aspect the ascendant, need for planetary support, and reception of the year’s disposition.
